title: Invesco launches IROXX tokenized fund for stablecoin reserve management
why_it_matters: The launch gives stablecoin issuers a regulated fund structure for holding eligible reserves while using blockchain-based ownership records. It also tests whether tokenization can improve reserve transparency without changing the underlying liquidity and investment risks of money market funds.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Invesco launches IROXX tokenized fund for stablecoin reserve management

Invesco introduced the IROXX government money market fund on November 17, combining short-term Treasury reserve assets with Superstate's FundOS infrastructure and USDC transaction support for eligible institutions.
